source.name: Footy Headlines – 'Japan 2026 World Cup Home Kit Released'
source.note: Kit maker. The 2026 home-kit launch article; its photos show no commercial logo anywhere on the shirt.
source.quote: Adidas has officially unveiled Japan’s new 2026 home kit, featuring light blue curved lines symbolizing the Japanese horizon.

summary: The 2026 home shirt carries no commercial sponsor logos - front, back, sleeves and shorts were checked on the kit-launch photos and in the September 2026 match against Uruguay; only the JFA crest and the adidas maker mark appear. adidas is the kit maker.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. adidas makes the kit.
